meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 模拟多个AI智能体协作开会并进行决策讨论的场景。适用于需要从多个专业角度分析问题、进行辩论和达成共识的场景，如项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个AI智能体协作开会并做出决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多角度分析问题并达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Simulate multi-agent meetings for collaborative decision-making
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze problems from multiple perspectives and reach consensus

howto.what: 装上后，当用户提出会议主题，Claude会模拟多个不同专业背景的AI智能体进行多阶段讨论，包括开场发言、自由讨论、辩论和总结，最后生成包含决策结论、关键论据、风险提示和后续行动的完整会议记录。
howto.when: 当用户需要从多个角度分析问题、需要不同领域专业知识碰撞，或要求模拟团队决策讨论时触发。

say.text: 请模拟技术架构评审会，讨论是否用微服务架构。
say.note: 会生成多个AI角色的辩论和最终建议。

say.text: 召开产品定价策略会议，角色用产品经理、市场分析师、销售总监和财务顾问。
say.note: 会进行市场分析和定价方案对比。

say.text: 模拟项目风险评估会议，输出风险清单和应对建议。
say.note: 风险会议会列出影响评估和措施。

howto.what_en: After installation, when the user provides a meeting topic, Claude simulates multiple AI agents with different expertise through stages such as opening statements, free discussion, debate, and summary, then outputs a complete meeting record with decisions, key arguments, risks, and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to analyze a problem from multiple angles, needs cross-domain expertise, or asks to simulate a team decision discussion.

say_en.text: Please simulate a technical architecture review meeting on whether to use microservices.
say_en.note: Generates debates and final advice from multiple AI roles.

say_en.text: Simulate a project risk assessment meeting and output a risk list with countermeasures.
say_en.note: The meeting will list impact assessments and actions.
